why: A2.2 G-A. A2.1 walks InvocationExpressionSyntax only, so a handle handed to a constructor (`new Wrapper(p, keep)`, `new StreamReader(s, leaveOpen: true)`) produces no calls[] entry although the constructor has its own functions[] record for the engine to apply here.
a2_contract: A2.2 records each object creation with a relevant argument as a calls[] entry: callee = the constructor's functions[] key (`Wrapper..ctor`, `System.IO.StreamReader..ctor`), sig/first_party as for invocations, args by declared ordinal (named resolved), site = the creation expression, form from its parent (`using var w = new ...` -> initializer). Body, params and verdicts unchanged.
